name: DocRaptor
description: integrates the DocRaptor HTML-to-PDF API (Prince-based) for PDF generation.
project_description:
Drupal 10+ version 
 DocRaptor is the only HTML to PDF API that uses the Prince PDF generator.

 Note, while DocRaptor appreciates the collaborative spirit behind this contribution, please note that DocRaptor does not officially maintain or provide technical support for this library.
